text:
alexa_cs: Heads up — AcmeHealth (acct 8902) invoice #7892 autopay tried 3x and all card attempts declined. They're mid-onboarding and this blocks access. Recommend manual collect + wire option. Anyone object?

sam_fin: Share decline codes & last4? Was it AVS/name mismatch or issuer?

alexa_cs: last4 4242. Decline reasons: `insufficient_funds`, then two `do_not_honor`. Attempts at 2026-03-22T09:14Z, 09:18Z, 09:43Z. Gateway didn't report AVS failure.

billing-bot: [automated] Payment-attempt log: invoice=7892 customer=AcmeHealth attempts=3 status=failed gateway=stripe region=us-west-2

mike_sales: They're in the 30-day onboarding trial, high ARR. Sales asks priority — if we manual-collect we need written consent. Also suggest offering wire instructions as primary to avoid repeat fails. :pray:

jin_finance: We can proceed with manual collect once CS uploads written consent and PO# (if available). Approve waiving late fee for this incident. CCing legal-bot for contract review.

alexa_cs: Will request consent now. PO is PO-23344 per customer's onboarding contact. Pasting customer reply below in a sec.

alexa_cs: Customer reply: "Corporate card hit auth window. We'll wire today if you send instructions. If you prefer, try one more card auth in 30m."

sam_fin: Prefer wire to avoid more declines and friction. Please create a manual invoice and set payment_method=wire so the system doesn't auto-retry card.

jin_finance: Approved. Create manual invoice, set payment_method=wire, waive late fee. Require customer to include exact reference (Invoice 7892 / PO-23344) and beneficiary name. Once we receive SWIFT/MT103, reconcile and mark paid.

alexa_cs: Copying wire template (we redact account details in public channels):
```Wire instructions (Redwood Inference — placeholder)
Bank: Example Bank PLC
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: (provided over secure channel)
IBAN/SWIFT: provided on request
Reference: Invoice 7892 / AcmeHealth / PO-23344
Note: Include exact reference to speed reconciliation.```

mike_sales: Also offer a one-time secure pay link as fallback — but disable auto-retries and note that attempting the card again may hit same decline. Wording: "We can send a secure one-time card pay link if you prefer — otherwise wire instructions attached."

alexa_cs: Sending both options now, asking for beneficiary confirmation and asking them to confirm they'll include reference. ETA from customer: EOD PST. I'll attach their confirmation to the billing ticket in Salesforce.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-4421 — manual-collect/wire for invoice 7892.

legal-bot: No contract terms blocking manual collect or wire settlement. Ensure consent and PO recorded.

jin_finance: Action summary: alexa_cs to capture written consent & beneficiary confirmation (ETA 2h). sam_fin to create manual invoice and flag payment_method=wire. mike_sales to prepare fallback pay link copy. Escalate to finance leadership if not settled by EOD PST.

alexa_cs: Got it — will update thread when customer confirms. Thanks everyone.
